stories.headline: GitHub's AI Scan adds advisory vulnerability findings to pull requests
stories.read_scope: Complete official release: supported language gaps, pull-request presentation, advisory-only behavior, exclusions, access and billing.
stories.summary: GitHub made AI Scan generally available for pull requests, adding model-generated security findings beside CodeQL results for languages and frameworks outside current CodeQL coverage. Findings can explain risk and suggest a repair, but they remain advisory: they cannot fail the check, block merges, inspect forked contributions, or scan Dependabot pull requests.
stories.why_it_matters: Security teams should measure precision, missed defects and reviewer workload before treating AI Scan as a control. Keep enforceable CodeQL and ruleset gates, label AI findings clearly, and require human verification of every suggested fix before merging.
stories.image_alt_intent: Pull request changes enter separate CodeQL and advisory AI scanning lanes, then converge at a human security review with blocking and nonblocking outcomes.

stories.headline: Agentic autofix couples security repairs with a fresh CodeQL check
stories.read_scope: Complete official release: repository exploration, repair generation, CodeQL validation, iteration, draft pull requests, policy controls, supported alerts and billing.
stories.summary: GitHub's agentic autofix now explores relevant repository files, proposes a repair, reruns CodeQL, and iterates before opening a draft pull request. Teams may assign one alert or batch up to twenty-five default-branch alerts. The validation confirms that CodeQL closes the original alert, not that the patch preserves every behavior or removes unrelated risks.
stories.why_it_matters: Treat the generated pull request as evidence to review, not a finished remediation. Run regression and abuse-case tests, inspect permission and dependency changes, confirm the alert's root cause, and track AI-credit and Actions-minute costs before scaling.
stories.image_alt_intent: Code scanning alert flows through repository exploration, proposed patch, CodeQL rerun, bounded iteration, draft pull request, regression tests and reviewer approval.
